empty.title: Nobody here yet
empty.description: Add the first person on your team to share the workload.

emptyRevoked.title: Nobody with revoked access

fields.name: Name

create.title: New person
create.emailStep: Start with the email: we'll check whether it's already on Vekoo.
create.detailsStep: This email is available. Now, the person's details and what they can do.
create.done: {{name}} is now part of the organization.
create.doneHint: Share the password you set: that's what they'll sign in with.
create.hereTitle: This person is already in the organization
create.hereDescription: To change what they can do, open their details.
create.revokedTitle: This person is here, with revoked access
create.revokedDescription: Restore their access and they come back with the same history.
create.elsewhereTitle: This email already has an account in another organization
create.elsewhereDescription: On Vekoo, each account belongs to a single organization. Ask this person for another email.

revoked.title: Access revoked on {{date}}
revoked.description: {{name}} can't sign in. Their data and history are still kept.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}'s access?
revoke.description: {{name}} is signed out of every device right away and can't sign in anymore. Conversations, cards and history stay as they are, and you can restore access whenever you want.
revoke.hint: {{name}} is signed out right away and can't come back. Nothing is lost, and you can restore access later.
revoke.notSelf: You can't revoke your own access.
revoke.lastOwner: This is the only owner, so the access can't be revoked and the account can't be deleted: the organization would be left with nobody to manage it.

delete.title: Delete {{name}} for good?
delete.description: This can't be undone. Conversations and cards assigned to {{name}} are left without an owner, and the name disappears from history. To just cut off access, cancel and use Revoke access.

password.title: Password
password.hint: For when {{name}} forgets the password or can't sign in.
password.effect: When you save, {{name}} is signed out of every device and signs in again with the new password.
password.done: {{name}}'s password changed. They need to sign in again.
password.ownInProfile: Your password is changed in <profile>your profile</profile>, where your current password is required.

selfLockout.title: You'll lose access to this area
selfLockout.description: With this change, you can no longer see the people settings. To get back in, someone with access has to give it back.

promote.title: Make {{name}} an owner?
promote.description: Owners can do anything in the organization, including changing other owners.

teams.description: Departments organize who handles what: conversations are transferred to them, and the calendar filters by them.

empty.title: No departments yet

noResults.description: Try another name or clear the filters.

fields.name: Name

delete.description_one: The person in this department stays in the organization and just leaves the department.
delete.description_other: The {{count}} people in this department stay in the organization and just leave the department.

members.title: Who's in it

delete.description_one: The person in this group ends up with no group, and the User defaults apply to them.
delete.description_other: The {{count}} people in this group end up with no group, and the User defaults apply to them.

members.title: Who's in this group

image.wrongType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
image.oneAtATime: Send one image at a time.

photo.title: Photo

photo.removeDescription: Your initials will appear in its place.

details.title: Your details

fields.name: Name
fields.emailHint: Whoever manages the organization can change your email.

password.title: Password
password.description: When you change it, you're signed out of your other devices. This one stays connected.
password.saved: Password changed. Your other devices need to sign in again.

device.title: On this device
device.description: Get messages and appointments even with Vekoo closed.

state.on: Alerts are on for this device
state.onHint: They arrive here even with the Vekoo screen closed.
state.off: Alerts are off for this device
state.offHint: Turn them on to get messages and appointments with Vekoo closed.
state.offAskHint: When you turn them on, your browser will ask for permission. Choose Allow.

notifications.enabled: Alerts turned on for this device.
notifications.disabled: Alerts turned off for this device.
notifications.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.

unsupported.title: This browser can't receive alerts
unsupported.description: Update your browser, or use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
unsupported.ios: On iPhone and iPad, alerts only work with Vekoo on the Home Screen, from iOS 16.4 on. In Safari, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen.

unavailable.title: Alerts aren't available here yet
unavailable.description: The server in this environment isn't set up to send alerts. If you need them, talk to whoever manages Vekoo.

blocked.title: Your browser is blocking alerts
blocked.description: Once blocked, Vekoo can't ask again. You have to allow them yourself, in your browser settings.

steps.chromium: Click the icon next to the site address, open Site settings, choose Allow under Notifications and reload the page.
steps.firefox: Click the lock next to the address, remove the block on Notifications and reload the page.
steps.safari: Open Safari, Settings, Websites, Notifications, choose Allow for this site and reload the page.
steps.ios: Open the device Settings, Notifications, Vekoo, and turn on Allow Notifications.
steps.android: Tap the icon next to the address, open Permissions or Site settings, turn on Notifications and reload the page.

failure.dismissed: The browser didn't get an answer. Tap Turn on alerts again and choose Allow.
failure.unavailable: We couldn't turn them on right now: the alert service isn't available.
failure.failed: We couldn't turn on alerts. Try again in a moment.

devices.title: Your devices
devices.description: Where your alerts arrive. Lost a device? Just remove it here.
devices.empty: No device is receiving alerts yet.
devices.label: {{browser}} on {{system}}
devices.removeDescription: That device stops receiving them. To come back, just turn them on again there.

about.title: How it works
about.description: It applies to each device separately.
about.closed: Alerts arrive even with the browser closed.
about.click: Tapping an alert opens Vekoo right at the conversation or appointment.
about.signOut: When you sign out, the device stops receiving them. When you sign back in, it resumes on its own.
about.pwa: On a phone, it works best with Vekoo installed. On iPhone and iPad, that's required.

logo.title: Logo

identity.name: Organization name
